modules.html:
A simple fix to keep your smile strong

Got a cavity or a small chip? We’ve got an easy solution! Our Montrose dental fillings help repair minor tooth damage and stop cavities from getting worse, so your smile stays healthy and strong.

We use tooth-colored materials that blend right in, so you won’t even notice the filling. The process is quick, comfortable, and designed to get you back to feeling your best in no time!
Restore and protect your smile with dental fillings

Stops cavities in their tracks

Our Montrose dental fillings prevent decay from spreading, protecting your tooth and supporting long-term health.

Quick and easy treatment

Most fillings take just one visit, so you can get back to your routine with comfort and confidence.

Natural-looking results

Composite fillings are color-matched to your enamel, making them virtually invisible in your smile.

Built to last

With proper daily care and regular cleanings, your filling can keep your tooth strong for many years.
Common questions about dental fillings

items.title: Will getting a filling hurt?
items.html: Your comfort comes first. We completely numb the area, and if you have dental anxiety, we’ll support you with extra comfort measures or sedation options.

items.title: How soon can I eat normally?
items.html: For tooth-colored composite fillings, you can eat once the numbness fades. We’ll guide you on what to avoid for the first few hours.

items.title: What if my filling falls out?
items.html: Call us right away. We’ll get you in quickly to repair or replace the filling so your tooth stays safe.

items.title: Can kids get fillings too?
items.html: Absolutely! Cavities happen at any age. We provide gentle, kid-friendly fillings to keep little smiles healthy and strong.

items.title: Can I still get a filling if my cavity doesn’t hurt?
items.html: Yes, and it’s the best choice. Cavities often grow silently. Early treatment saves you from bigger problems later.

modules.html:
How dental fillings restore your tooth

  • Initial consultation: Dr. Amin or Dr. Shinta evaluates your tooth using a visual exam and digital x-rays.
  • Treatment planning: We review your options and choose the ideal filling material for comfort, strength, and appearance.
  • Precise application: Decay is gently removed and replaced with a durable, biocompatible filling.
  • Final polish & care: We shape and refine the filling for a perfect bite, then share tips to protect your newly restored tooth.
